caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a blue cushioned seat. The chair has a brown frame with a curved, decorative backrest consisting of four horizontal slats that are wavy and ornately detailed. The legs of the chair are straight and joined by horizontal support bars near the bottom. The background is a blank, off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or features present. The artist's signature appears in small text in the lower left corner.
title: Side Chair
